tools.name: list_supported_routes
tools.description: Lists the visa routes Visa Engine covers (visa keys, names, kind and country), the destinations its visitor-visa checks accept, and the languages it answers in. tools.name: get_visa_requirements
tools.description: Explains what a visa requires: the criteria or checklist, typical evidence, official sources and when they were last checked. Also answers whether a visa is needed to visit a country on a given passport. Give visaType (e.g. O-1A, UK-GTV) or a destination country. Examples: UK visitor visa requiremen

tools.name: check_visa_readiness
tools.description: Readiness check for one visa. For visitor visas (US B-1/B-2, UK Standard Visitor, Schengen, Canada visitor, Australia 600) it takes the traveller's passport country, destination, purpose, month, trip length and a short list of answers, and returns a readiness band, areas, findings and recommendation
